title: E0062-2 The World Behind the Curtain
lyrics:
[Intro]
[Spoken - low, quiet, intimate tone]
Who
are you?

[Verse 1]
The world
is full of secrets

Those with eyes will see
Those with ears will hear

[Verse 2]
Not the imitation made by others
But eyes and ears made by yourself
Then behind the world you see
The true faces and sounds
You will see and hear

[Bridge]
Without losing your mind
You cannot find
That secret

Reciting a script
Written by someone else
Like a parrot
Just living as if it were your own

[Outro]
The world
is full of secrets

Can you see
Can you hear

Can you face
The real you

The world
is still full of secrets

[End]
style: Style: Korean experimental hip-hop with abstract spoken word, Sparse electronic beats, atmospheric synths, and glitch textures, Vocals are raw, fragmented, with pauses and emphasis on rhythm of speech, Tempo irregular, emphasizing mood shifts and unpredictability, Mood: surreal, intense, like decoding hidden truths in a futuristic soundscape
